title: Pangasinan Half Marathon 2026 Review: Lingayen's Capitol 21K
seo_title: Pangasinan Half Marathon 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: Pangasinan Half Marathon 2026: September 5 at Capitol Compound, Lingayen. UR Events' provincial Ilocos-region 21K.
dek: Set for 5 September 2026 at the Capitol Compound in Lingayen, Pangasinan, this UR Events half marathon brings road racing to the Ilocos region's coastal province.
verdict: The Pangasinan Half Marathon is a UR Events production at the Capitol Compound in Lingayen — Pangasinan's provincial capital, known for its Hundred Islands National Park and its bangus (milkfish) industry. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K). Lingayen's coastal plain is predominantly flat, making for a fast course. September is the tail of the wet season in the Ilocos region. A solid provincial Philippine half marathon in an under-represented region.

sections.heading: Lingayen: Pangasinan's Capital
paragraphs: Lingayen is Pangasinan's capital — a coastal city known for its capitol building, the Lingayen Gulf, and its proximity to the Hundred Islands. [1] UR Events handles production. The flat coastal terrain promises a fast course.
